main_text.p: nullum parti innocenti superfit remedium, tale duellum, vera erit defensio, & consequenter contra provocantem ut iniquum invasorem licita. Ubi enim iniqua est offensio, ibi regulariter defensio est permissa, & licita. Ut semetipsum tueatur per calumniam accusatus, adversus vim ab iniquo illatam accusatore. Praesertim cum innocens non resistat ordinationi divinae, de obediendo magistratui, sed pareat, nec hac ratione involet in officium magistratus, ut qui ei concef-sit licentiam semet defendendi. Quasi eum eligat in justitiae ministrum, ut accusatorem, quem per calumniam accusasse dicit, occidat, saltem adversus eum se tueatur, nisi nocens haberi velit. page.notes: Doubtful readings: "involet" and "hac" (possibly with a diacritic in print); "concef-sit" is read as a hyphenated line break of "concessit", the printed hyphen is kept. "justitiae" is set with a j as in the print. The long s is rendered as s throughout. The paragraph runs over the page end on "con-".
